clips.title: The story
paras: On Elder Rise, Magatha Grimtotem challenges Cairne Bloodhoof's vision for the tauren. The Grimtotem matriarch and Thunder Bluff's Elder Crone is a formidable shaman and political schemer.

Magatha Grimtotem leads the Grimtotem tribe from Elder Rise, with her own retinue and bodyguards. She gained authority through an arranged union, then her mate died suddenly in a climbing accident. Her reclusive tribe follows her as its political and spiritual leader. Magatha preaches tauren dominance, unlike Cairne Bloodhoof. She sees other mortal races as intruders on Kalimdor, to be eradicated or swept aside.

Though Magatha openly disdains other races, she was among the first to advocate admitting the Forsaken to the Horde. She says the tauren can teach the undead spiritual balance and help them reclaim their humanity. Magatha also works directly with the Royal Apothecary Society beneath Thunder Bluff, consulting figures such as Apothecary Zamah about practical alchemy and arcane relics.
